event_changes: Clarified the Paenibacillus descriptor's pinned native NCBI-name correspondence versus distinct R226 GTDB-name and NCBI-defined reference populations, preserving unresolved experimental-stock placement (#2869). This note-only intermediate leaves the separate native mapping correction pending.

existing_descriptor.notes: The local kg-microbe NCBI2GTDB crosswalk was unavailable during curation; direct inspection of the GTDB bac120 taxonomy table showed Paenibacillus polymyxa split across five GTDB species clusters with no majority.

existing_stock.notes: Raw genome reads reported under SRA run SRR33221449.

notes.before: The local kg-microbe NCBI2GTDB crosswalk was unavailable during curation; direct inspection of the GTDB bac120 taxonomy table showed Paenibacillus polymyxa split across five GTDB species clusters with no majority.
notes.after: The pinned kg-microbe NCBI2GTDB.tsv.gz correspondence (SHA-256 761d5537a7edb4b0133e88e7bbc85570cf3cb6f2555b9f9ce6cca3e1056a0ddd) resolves this species descriptor by the native ncbi_name route, with no exact NCBITaxon:1406 rows, to three GTDB alternatives: Paenibacillus polymyxa, P. polymyxa_B and P. polymyxa_C. This source's GTDB release is not established. A separate verified R226 GTDB name query finds 193 genomes in five bins (83 unsuffixed, 65 _B, 20 _C, 24 _D, 1 _E); it is not an NCBI-defined population. R226's NCBI correspondence workbook, Species row 331, instead reports 128 genomes across six taxa: unsuffixed 55.47%, _B 23.44%, _C 9.38%, _D 7.81%, P. ottowii 3.12%, _E 0.78%. The original five-candidate table's release could not be established. These reference populations do not assign the experimental root isolate to a GTDB species; the primary paper reports raw reads SRR33221449, not an assembly-grounded GTDB assignment.
